description: This file defines data structures, enums, and classes related to calendar events, including locations, attendees, hosts, and the unified calendar event output format, for use in a NestJS application.

classes.name: CalendarEventVideoLocation
classes.description: Represents a video conference location with optional credentials and identifiers.

classes.name: CalendarEventPhoneLocation
classes.description: Represents a phone conference location with optional PIN, password, and region code.

classes.name: CalendarEventSipLocation
classes.description: Represents a SIP conference location with optional label, pin, and password.

classes.name: CalendarEventMoreLocation
classes.description: Represents an additional or 'more' type location with URL and optional label.

classes.name: CalendarEventHost
classes.description: Contains information about an event host, including email, name, and response status.

classes.name: calendarEventOwner
classes.description: Represents the owner of the calendar event with email and optional name.

classes.name: CalendarEventAttendee
classes.description: Details of an attendee, including email, response status, and optional flags.

classes.name: DateTimeWithZone
classes.description: Represents a date-time with timezone information.

classes.name: UnifiedCalendarEventOutput
classes.description: Main output class for a unified calendar event, including start/end times, title, description, locations, attendees, status, hosts, owner, and source.

classes.name: GetUnifiedCalendarEventOutput
classes.description: Wrapper class for the response containing status and the calendar event data.

methods.name: getSchemaPath
methods.description: Utility function from @nestjs/swagger to generate schema paths for nested models.
